data.one_liner: Widget that animates text changes like SwiftUI's numericText.
data.what_it_does: NumericText automatically animates any text change, providing a smooth transition effect. It supports most Text widget parameters and requires no external dependencies.
use_when: Need a quick animated numeric display
Want to replace Text with minimal configuration
Require smooth text change animation without custom code
avoid_when: Need fine-grained control over animation curves
Require complex animation sequences beyond text
Performance critical apps with many animated texts
strengths: Smooth animation out of the box
weaknesses: Not suitable for complex animation flows
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
